QuestInfo.name: [Home] Gold Beach's Bounty
QuestInfo.0: Ask Little Richie, the owner of Gold Beach Resort, about the postcard.
QuestInfo.1:
You took a short break at a seaside bar while Little Richie looked into the postcard.

Amy thought the food was complimentary, and racked up a tab of 11,000,000 mesos! What are you going to do?
